text: Where did SDN genuinely win, and what do those environments have in common?
choices: Data centre fabrics, wide-area traffic engineering, and SD-WAN — all cases where one organisation controls everything and the optimisation benefit is measurable
explanation: Google's B4 runs its inter-data-centre WAN at close to 100% utilisation against the 30-40% typical of traditionally engineered networks. It struggled in heterogeneous, incrementally grown, multi-vendor environments — which describes most enterprise networks.
